objective: Run typed field rules in a defined order with complete key coverage, safe error ownership and exact callback lifetime.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Mapped per-field callbacks and optional error records remain current TypeScript techniques.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Local form-rule evaluation is practical library work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Symbol ownership, short-circuiting and callback protocols transfer to other typed pipelines.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Explicit reflection boundaries and generic helpers fit this intermediate mapped-type task.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Ignoring Symbol rules or treating inherited names as errors loses valid checks and confuses consumers.

defects: All original for-in boards ignored Symbol rules and traversed inherited enumerable rules.
Plain error bags could mishandle prototype-like keys or expose inherited names as apparent errors.
Junior indexed method invocation bound a receiver unlike reference/senior plain function calls.
Exact rule ownership/order, callback arity, thrown-marker propagation and independent error dictionaries were incomplete.
rationale: Replace for-in with own-key reflection/enumerability filtering and a generic K helper so checks/values retain T[K]. Explain the boundary cast under the explicit rule-key contract. Use prototype-safe fresh errors, including empty strings as real messages. Six runtime assertions inspect Symbol/constructor/__proto__ keys and absent inherited names; integer/string/Symbol field order with hidden/inherited rules ignored; one-argument callbacks; exact throw/stop behavior; independent mutable bags;100 fields by20 checks; and strict callbacks with undefined receiver. Normalize junior and the final accepted alternative to plain local callback invocation. The baseline alternative used indexed invocation on inputs that did not observe this; it was updated after the explicit protocol repair. Preserve existing early-stop tests rather than claiming them absent. Add Symbol-value/error static evidence. Target linear own-key plus total-rule count excluding callback work.

objective: Apply defined own patch fields in order while preserving source metadata and the required Profile result.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Partial and immutable ordered updates remain current TypeScript patterns.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Applying sequential form edits is practical state processing.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Undefined policy, own fields and empty-input identity transfer to other merge operations.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Bounded fixed-field patches isolate the intermediate iteration/copy objective.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: A supposedly complete result can lose required fields through undefined or lose opaque source metadata.

defects: Reference/senior spread explicit undefined while junior ignored it; the policy was unspecified and complete-result typing could be false at runtime.
Junior returned a new object on zero patches despite the stated original-object behavior and lost extra source fields.
The original junior passed all old value-only tests.
rationale: Define one explicit policy: undefined own patch values are ignored and inherited fields do not apply, preserving required Profile fields. Ref/senior filter own entries before spread; junior copies current per patch and updates defined owned fixed fields. Preserve no-patches exact identity and fresh plain copies even for empty patches. Add one visible undefined-policy example and three hidden runtime assertions for frozen/Symbol/literal-prototype metadata, empty/no-op identity, sequential zero/empty/undefined/inherited values and1000 patches over100 metadata fields. Add a static explicitly undefined Partial accepted while result remains Profile. Target O(n*m) for patch count times copied starting fields; patches cannot grow metadata, and unsupported dimensional analysis remains hidden/unpenalized under419.

objective: Construct independent exact two-field runtime projections rather than relying on a Pick type to remove metadata.

defects: Additional string/Symbol metadata and per-occurrence fresh-object behavior were implicit.
A rest-copy that removed body/author but retained every other field passed all old cases.
Old output-key tests checked only own enumerable string keys on records with no extra metadata.
rationale: Retain every correct original board and the junior alternative. Clarify Pick as static view, own/inherited stable source data, duplicate IDs/references and exact two-own-key fresh plain output for every occurrence/call. Three runtime assertions inspect Symbol/internal/literal-prototype metadata exclusion using Reflect.ownKeys, frozen repeated sources, output mutation independence, inherited values, independent empty arrays and1000 repeated records producing1000 different previews. Add a negative static body access through the function result. Target linear bounded property reads; body/author/metadata contents are ignored. A canonical known-right title-first preview exposed an overstrict key-enumeration assertion; the new exact-key checks now sort the two string keys, accepting either construction order while still rejecting extra Symbol/string keys.
